title: Second court defeat for Trump's deep-sea mining ambitions
paragraphs: The Trump administration's plans to begin deep-sea mining in the Pacific have hit a second legal setback after a federal judge ruled plans to lease areas of sea-floor off the Northern Mariana Islands violated the Endangered Species Act (ESA).
The court's decision follows a similar ruling over a proposed lease sale off American Samoa.
Opposition groups who lodged the Northern Mariana Islands lawsuit said they were concerned deep-sea mining could cause long-term damage to the ocean ecosystem.
